rules.name: Subscription Auto-Renewal Consent
rules.statement: A customer may only have a subscription automatically renewed if they have explicitly opted in to recurring billing within the portal.
rules.condition: when a subscription term is approaching expiration
exceptions: Customer explicitly cancels before the renewal window closes
rules.if_violated: The system blocks the renewal transaction and notifies the customer that the service will lapse at the end of the current term.
rules.rationale: To prevent unauthorized recurring charges and ensure customer trust in the self-service portal.

parameters.name: renewal_window_days
parameters.description: days before expiry when opt-in is required

rules.name: Loyalty Point Redemption Cap
rules.statement: A customer must not redeem loyalty points for a single order if the points value exceeds the maximum allowed discount percentage for that order total.
rules.condition: when a customer attempts to apply loyalty points during checkout
exceptions: Promotional events explicitly override standard caps
rules.if_violated: The system rejects the redemption request and displays the maximum allowable discount amount.
rules.rationale: To prevent revenue leakage and ensure profitability on high-value orders while maintaining reward value.

parameters.name: max_discount_percentage
parameters.description: maximum percentage of order value redeemable via points

rules.name: Profile Data Archival Integrity
rules.statement: Archived customer profiles must retain all historical order and interaction data and must never be modified after the archival status is confirmed.
rules.condition: when a customer profile is moved to an archived state
exceptions: System recovery operations initiated by senior administrators with dual authorization
rules.if_violated: The system rejects the archival command and logs the attempt as a compliance violation.
rules.rationale: To ensure audit trails remain immutable for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution.

parameters.name: retention_period_years
parameters.description: years data must be retained post-archival

rules.name: Subscription Tier Downgrade Restriction
rules.statement: A customer may only downgrade their subscription tier immediately after the current billing cycle concludes, not mid-cycle.
rules.condition: when a customer requests a change to their active subscription plan
exceptions: Platform-initiated service termination due to non-payment or policy breach
rules.if_violated: The system queues the downgrade request to take effect at the start of the next billing period.
rules.rationale: To protect revenue stability and prevent customers from exploiting mid-cycle price differences.

parameters.name: billing_cycle_frequency
parameters.description: frequency of the billing cycle (e.g., monthly, yearly)

rules.name: Demand-Based Fee Adjustment
rules.statement: The system must adjust delivery fees and commissions in real-time based on current demand, weather, and traffic conditions.
rules.condition: during order allocation and confirmation phases
exceptions: emergency service tiers with fixed pricing
rules.if_violated: revenue is sub-optimized during peak times and SLA adherence risks increase
rules.rationale: dynamic pricing maximizes revenue and ensures timely deliveries during supply-demand fluctuations

parameters.name: demand_multiplier
parameters.description: scaling factor applied to base fees based on order volume density

parameters.name: weather_adjustment_factor
parameters.description: coefficient applied to fees based on adverse weather conditions

parameters.name: traffic_congestion_threshold
parameters.description: traffic level at which fees begin to increase

rules.name: Service Area Compliance
rules.statement: Orders originating from addresses outside the active Service Area Definition must be rejected by the Order Allocation Engine.
rules.condition: at the moment of order submission
exceptions: manual override by Platform Operator for verified high-value customers
rules.if_violated: the order is not processed and the customer receives a rejection notification
rules.rationale: prevents logistical failures and ensures accurate inventory and routing availability

parameters.name: active_service_area_id
parameters.description: identifier of the currently valid geospatial boundary

rules.name: Travel Time Matrix Recalculation
rules.statement: The system must recalculate estimated arrival times and optimal delivery paths whenever a Service Area Definition is modified.
rules.condition: immediately upon publication of a new Service Area Definition version
exceptions: scheduled maintenance windows with pre-calculated buffers
rules.if_violated: delivery estimates become inaccurate leading to SLA breaches and customer dissatisfaction
rules.rationale: ensures route constraints and travel times reflect the latest operational geography

parameters.name: recalculation_trigger_event
parameters.description: event type that initiates the matrix update process

rules.name: Financial Settlement Validation
rules.statement: The system must prevent the finalization of a Financial Transaction Record if no valid Store Partner Agreement exists for the involved Store Partner.
rules.condition: during the financial settlement handover phase
exceptions: manual dispute resolution initiated by the Platform Operator
rules.if_violated: the transaction fails to settle, resulting in revenue loss and potential legal liability
rules.rationale: ensures revenue share calculations are based on current contractual terms

parameters.name: agreement_validity_status
parameters.description: boolean flag indicating if the agreement is active and unexpired

rules.name: Atomic Inventory Locking
rules.statement: A specific inventory unit must be locked exclusively to a single Order Request until the fulfillment task is completed or the order is cancelled.
rules.condition: When an Order Request is created and assigned to a Store Partner
rules.if_violated: The system rejects the order assignment and flags the inventory for manual audit
rules.rationale: Prevents overselling and revenue leakage by ensuring one unit serves only one customer at a time

parameters.name: lock_duration
parameters.description: Maximum time a unit can remain locked before auto-release

rules.name: Perishable Priority Allocation
rules.statement: Inventory units for perishable items must be prioritized for allocation to orders based on their proximity to the expiration date.
rules.condition: When allocating inventory for perishable goods across multiple eligible orders
rules.if_violated: The system skips the allocation and flags the order for manual review to prevent waste
rules.rationale: Minimizes food waste and ensures regulatory compliance regarding food safety and shelf-life

parameters.name: expiry_threshold
parameters.description: Time window defining 'proximity to expiration' for prioritization

rules.name: Real-Time Sync Discrepancy Flagging
rules.statement: The system must flag a synchronization discrepancy if the data link latency exceeds the defined threshold or if a sync failure is detected.
rules.condition: During continuous reconciliation between POS systems and the digital platform
rules.if_violated: The system halts new order assignments and triggers an immediate alert for manual intervention
rules.rationale: Ensures data integrity and prevents financial loss due to unrecorded inventory changes

parameters.name: latency_threshold
parameters.description: Maximum acceptable delay in seconds for data synchronization

rules.name: Automatic Lock Release on Timeout
rules.statement: Locked stock must be automatically released if the Order Request is not confirmed within the allocated time window.
rules.condition: When an Order Request remains in a pending confirmation state
rules.if_violated: The inventory remains locked, causing potential overselling and blocking other valid orders
rules.rationale: Prevents inventory hoarding and ensures availability for other customers during peak times

parameters.name: confirmation_window
parameters.description: Maximum time allowed for order confirmation before lock release

rules.name: Settlement-After-Delivery-Proof
rules.statement: Financial distribution must only occur after a valid Delivery Proof is recorded.
rules.condition: When calculating settlement amounts for a completed delivery order
exceptions: Force majeure events where delivery proof is technically impossible but legally accepted via alternative verification
rules.if_violated: The system must block the settlement transaction and flag the event for manual audit review
rules.rationale: Prevents revenue leakage by ensuring goods were actually delivered before funds are released

parameters.name: valid_delivery_proof_status
parameters.description: The specific status value indicating successful delivery verification

rules.name: High-Risk-Transaction-Pause
rules.statement: Transactions involving high-risk indicators must be paused for manual verification before settlement.
rules.condition: When a transaction risk score exceeds the high-risk threshold defined in the risk model
exceptions: Customer explicitly waives verification for low-value transactions under a specific trust tier
rules.if_violated: The system must automatically reverse the pending settlement and initiate a fraud investigation workflow
rules.rationale: Mitigates financial loss from fraud and chargebacks in a high-volume, low-margin environment

parameters.name: high_risk_threshold
parameters.description: The numerical score value that triggers a manual review pause

rules.name: Revenue-Reconciliation-Continuity
rules.statement: Platform revenue shares must be reconciled against store partner settlements in real-time.
rules.condition: During every financial settlement cycle for a transaction
rules.if_violated: The system must halt further settlements for the affected store partner until the discrepancy is resolved
rules.rationale: Ensures accurate financial distribution and prevents overpayment or underpayment between parties

parameters.name: reconciliation_tolerance
parameters.description: The maximum allowable variance percentage between calculated and actual shares

rules.name: Immutable-Audit-Trail-Generation
rules.statement: An immutable audit trail must be generated for every Financial Transaction Record and Settlement event.
rules.condition: Immediately upon creation or modification of any financial transaction record
rules.if_violated: The system must reject the transaction and log a critical error for compliance investigation
rules.rationale: Provides a non-repudiable record for regulatory compliance and dispute resolution

parameters.name: audit_retention_period
parameters.description: The minimum duration the audit trail must be stored securely
